features: Registration Desk can add genuinely new dancers through the shared official BDC ID service
Registration Desk bib is optional at initial registration and can be assigned later
Adds Generate New Registration Desk Link action when the secure token is unavailable
Regenerating the Registration Desk link changes only the access token and preserves competitors, bibs, check-ins and ready status
Registration live sync counts NULL or blank bibs as Missing Bibs
Automatic judge YES and clear/NO controls have larger touch targets and safer visual spacing
No scoring calculation or points logic changed
No Staging or Production deployment performed
